user.title: IRBridge
user.description: Generate IR codes on-the-fly for your climate device. Pick a protocol; the next step sends a test command so you can check it before saving.

test.title: Did it work?
test.description:
Sent **{protocol} · cool · {temp} °C** to your air conditioner.

If it turned on and shows {temp} °C, the protocol is right. If nothing happened, clear the box below and try another one — brand names are a poor guide, and a unit sold under one brand often speaks another protocol.

error.test_failed: No response from the air conditioner. Try a different protocol, or check that the blaster can reach the unit.

abort.infrared_unavailable: This Home Assistant version has no infrared platform. IRBridge requires Home Assistant 2026.7 or newer.

init.title: IRBridge
init.description: The next step sends a test command, so a protocol change is checked before it replaces your current setup.

test.title: Did it work?
test.description:
Sent **{protocol} · cool · {temp} °C** to your air conditioner.

If it responded, confirm below to save. If nothing happened, clear the box and pick another protocol — your current settings stay untouched until you confirm.

error.test_failed: No response from the air conditioner. Try a different protocol, or check that the blaster can reach the unit.
